entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Manish Kumar Tiwari - Advocate for the applicant.
Smt. Geeta Yadav - G.A. for the respondent/State.
Trial Court record as well as appellate Court record has been received.
Heard on admission.
Record perused.
Prima facie, this revision seems to be arguable.
Hence, admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on I.A. No.16715/2025 , an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the applicant, pending revision.

Applicant was convicted for commission of offence under Sections 26(2)(i) read with Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and was sentenced to undergo RI for three months and fine of Rs.20,000/- with default stipulation, vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 22.06.2023, passed in Criminal Appeal No.786/2017 (State of M.P. Vs. Sunil Mewada and Another)
by learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Ashta, District Sehore (M.P.).

entities.text: State of M.P. Vs. Sunil Mewada and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The said judgment was challenged by the applicant by filing appeal before the Court of Sessions.

Learned JMFC, Baihar,
District Balaghat vide appeal judgment dated 10.07.2025 passed in Cr.A.No.152/2023 (Sunil Mewada Vs. State of M.P.) dismissed the appeal and affirmed the judgment of conviction and order of sentence passed by 2 CRR-3254-2025 learned JMFC, Ashta, District Sehore.

entities.text: Cr.A.No.152/2023 (Sunil Mewada Vs. State of M.P.)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hence, this revision.

Learned counsel for the applicant has referred para 52 of the appellate Court judgement and has submitted that analyst report Exhibit P/14 was not supplied to the accused in compliance of Rule 2.4.2:6 as such he has been deprived of his valuable right.
It is submitted that learned trial Court has concluded that said report was not supplied to it.
Therefore, the conviction recorded by the learned trial Court and affirmed by the appellate Court are erroneous and he has fair chances to succeed in the revision.
It is further submitted that he has already suffered almost 20 days in jail.
Therefore, he has prayed to suspend the jail sentence and grant of bail.

sentences.text:
On the other hand, learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant and has submitted that there is concurrent finding of fact and there is no illegality,
incorrectness or impropriety in the judgment of conviction and order of sentence by the Courts below.

Considering the submissions put forth by learned counsel for the parties including the finding recorded by both the Courts below and the fact that this is a new revision and there is no possibility of hearing of this criminal revision in the near future, I deem it a fit case for suspension of jail sentence of the applicant.
Therefore, without commenting on merits of the case, I.A. No.16715/2025 is allowed .

It is directed that the jail sentence of applicant - Sunil Mewada shall remain suspended during pendency of this revision petition and he be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
3 CRR-3254-2025 (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 03.11.2025 and on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the trial Court in that regard.
List this revision for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy as per rules.
